decision.rationale: TXN-008022 is a 54.35 EUR charge on card CRD-000028 at Ashgrove Athletic Club (MER-000063), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-08-29 and posted on 2026-08-30. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 55 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The case has no documents and no written cancellation confirmation from the merchant, so there is no effective cancellation date to compare with the charge date. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone 'last month'. That is only a claim, and if the call was in September it would be after the 2026-08-29 charge. Under recurring-no-proof, we ask the merchant for its cancellation records and the subscription terms before deciding. If those records show the cancellation took effect before 2026-08-29, the credit would be the disputed charge of 54.35 EUR only.

proposed_actions.note: Please send your cancellation records for this cardholder's subscription, including any cancellation request (such as by phone) and the date it took effect. Please also send the subscription terms that applied to the charge of 54.35 EUR made on 2026-08-29.
